silicon.heading: Bio-silica & silicon.
silicon.description: Developing biogenic silica from rice husk for rubber, concrete and industrial applications. We are evaluating green silicon pathways to support India’s materials supply chains.

cbg.heading: Compressed biogas.
cbg.description: Developing compressed biogas from agricultural residues for transport, industry and city gas networks. Planned digestate recovery adds a circular route for returning nutrients to farmland.

saf.heading: Sustainable aviation fuel.
saf.description: Evaluating aviation fuel pathways from non-food biomass. Feasibility studies, feedstock planning and potential technology collaboration guide this future development area.

energy.heading: Renewable power.
energy.description: Planning solar and wind power to support future industrial energy needs. Our wider development approach also considers process efficiency and waste-heat recovery.
energy.visualContext: Solar and wind concepts supplied by the user; not evidence of an approved design or operations.
